name: @2one/design-library
title: 2one Design Language System
description: shadcn/ui components re-skinned to the 2one design tokens. Grayscale (light + audited dark), pill buttons, Satoshi headings + Inter body.

conventions.styles: import '@2one/design-library/styles' once at the app root
conventions.tailwind: v4 — consumer runs Tailwind and @source's the package dist

theme.note: Both a light (:root) and an audited dark (.dark) palette are defined; toggle via the exported ThemeProvider (adds a .dark class), which activates the shadcn dark: utilities. Same grayscale system in both — no brand/accent hue. Both themes pass the APCA audit (npm run a11y).
theme.hues: grayscale; danger + success are the only hues, reserved for validation

overrides: Button: rounded-full (pill) instead of shadcn's rounded-md — the 2one signature.

twoOneOnly.name: Logo
twoOneOnly.rule: black on light / white on dark; never recolored, rotated, or distorted; min width 96px.

twoOneOnly.name: AppBar
twoOneOnly.rule: mobile top bar, 64px; leading = back/menu only; max one trailing action; title never blank.

twoOneOnly.name: BottomNavItem
twoOneOnly.rule: one tab in a bottom nav; compose several; only one selected at a time.

notCovered: Combobox / Date Picker / Data Table / Typography are shadcn composition patterns, not single components — build from the primitives above.
history: Replaced the earlier hand-built Figma-1:1 set (12 components) with this shadcn-based system on user direction (2026-08-10). Old components removed.
